Name: Talkohlooeys Portrait Recolor - Goth Haley (Seasonal)
Author: helpfulDeathgod
Description:
A quick and dirty (not really) recolor of the talkohlooeys' seasonal portraits for Haley, including a change of clothing color, to match with the sprites for stanloona420's Goth Haley mod. I did this for myself, but I figured I'd share.

Packed together for a simple install, in a simple .zip folder.

[b]Required Mods![/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url] and their requirements
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9861]Goth Haley - Seasonal[/url] and their requirements (if you want the matching sprites)﻿

[b]How to Install
[/b]unzip
drop "/Portraits" into "[CP] 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits/assets"
Say yes to overwrite
ta dah!


If you see yourself uninstalling Goth Haley, then make sure to back up the Haley portraits in /Beach, /Festivals/SpiritsEve, /Festivals/FlowerDance, and /Haley.
Or just re-download the original talkohlooeys.


And [b]of course, message me if you want it taken down.[/b] I'm not evil lol

Future Plans: Shie's Portraits Goth Haley, if Shie ever finishes Seasonal Portraits.
I know what I like.
